10. ADJUST TOTAL PAELOAD
(a) To prevent the steering rack teeth from damaging the oil
seal lip, temporarily install the RH and LH rack ends.
(b) Torque the rack guide spring cap.
Torque: 25 N,m (250 kgf.cm, 18 ft,lbf)
(c) Return the rack guide spring cap 12 ° .
N
(d) Using SST, turn the control valve shaft right and left 1 or
2 times.
SST 09616--00010
{e) Loosen the rack guide spring cap until the rack guide
spring is not functioning.
N
(f) Using SST and torque wrench, lighten the rack guide
spring cap until the preload is within the specification.
SST 09616--00010
Preload (turning):
0.9 - 1.3 N-m (9 - 13 kgf.cm, 8.0 - 11.5 in.•lbf}
N
(g) Using a punch and a hammer, stake 2 parts in opposing
positions on the rack guide spring cap.
(h) Recheck the total preload.
Preload (turning):
0.9-1.3 N,m (9-13 kgf,cm, 8.0-11.5 ln.,lbf)
(i} Remove the RH and LH rack ends.
